netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n4 n2 n3 VSS
PMOS M2 n4 n2 n5 VDD
L Ls n3 VSS
L Ld VDD n4
C Ct1 n4 n5
C Ct2 n5 VSS
C Cout n5 VOUT1
L Lout n5 VDD
rationale: The proposed topology improves the power efficiency by introducing a current-reuse architecture with a cascode PMOS transistor to reduce the tail current while maintaining gain and noise performance. This directly targets the excessive IDD violation (12.38 mA vs 10 mA limit) without degrading the already-passing S11, S21, or NF metrics. The addition of a cascode PMOS (M2) in series with the NMOS (M1) enables current reuse between the input and output stages, reducing the total DC current drawn from VDD. The inductor Lg remains for input matching, and the output inductor Lout preserves the narrowband response. This is a minimal yet effective edit to fix the binding constraint (IDD) while preserving stability and performance.
